notes.title: [h1]Lucky Gems Version 1.1 Update Notes[/h1]
notes.content:
[h2]New Content[/h2] 
Added a new kind of mischievous monster, it will cause continuous damage, you need to use the gold coins you earned to repair the rainbow, and you can only win when the rainbow is fully restored. Added different types and values of gems, you can mine more gems to increase your income, but also pay attention to the monster’s attack, do not let the rainbow be completely destroyed. Added some new sound effects and animations, making the game more vivid and interesting. [h2]Optimization and Fixes[/h2] Optimized the game interface and operation, making the game more smooth and easy to use. Fixed some known bugs and errors, improving the game stability and compatibility. Adjusted the game difficulty and balance, making the game more fair and challenging. We hope you like this update, if you have any suggestions or feedback, please contact us through our official channels, we will listen to your opinions carefully, and constantly improve and perfect our game. Thank you for your support!
